name: treasury
description: Typed operator and agent command surface for Agent Treasury's spend-and-earn authority.

groups.name: safety
groups.description: Inspect Treasury's non-negotiable financial safety invariants.

commands.name: invariants
commands.description: Show the structural constraints every Treasury implementation must preserve.

groups.name: book
groups.description: Inspect ownership of the source-of-funds boundary.

commands.name: get
commands.description: Read an operator custody book.

commands.name: create
commands.description: Create the operator custody book from generated-proto JSON.

groups.name: identity
groups.description: Inspect the fail-closed agent identity boundary.

commands.name: describe
commands.description: Describe the identity domain boundary.

commands.name: describe
commands.description: Describe the rail domain boundary.

groups.name: evidence
groups.description: Inspect the append-only spend evidence boundary.

commands.name: describe
commands.description: Describe the evidence domain boundary.

groups.name: ledger
groups.description: Inspect the durable Money Ledger emission boundary and choose where settlements post.

commands.name: describe
commands.description: Describe the ledger domain boundary.

commands.name: emissions-list
commands.description: Read durable Money Ledger emission status, optionally filtered by exact source identity or delivery state.

commands.name: destination-show
commands.description: Show the Money Ledger book and account settlements post to, or why none is chosen, with how many settlements are waiting.

commands.name: destination-set
commands.description: Choose the existing Money Ledger book and account settlements post to. Treasury checks the choice against Money Ledger (book exists and is not archived, account is in that book, currency is USD) and stores nothing otherwise. It never creates a book or account; list the choices with `money-ledger ledger books-list` and `accounts-list`. Waiting settlements are delivered on the next drain.

flags.name: book-id
flags.description: Id of an existing, active USD Money Ledger book.

flags.name: account-id
flags.description: Id of an account in that book.

groups.name: authorization
groups.description: Propose spending and read authoritative authorization decisions.

commands.name: propose
commands.description: Ask Treasury to authorize one charge under an existing mandate.

flags.name: settlement-id
flags.description: Preallocated settlement identifier committed by the same spend approval.

flags.name: instrument-id
flags.description: Exact Treasury instrument committed before authorization.

flags.name: settlement-idempotency-key
flags.description: Stable settlement retry key committed before authorization.

commands.name: get
commands.description: Read one authorization and its constraint-specific decision.

groups.name: mandate
groups.description: Create, list and revoke signed spending authority.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List mandates visible to the authenticated agent.

commands.name: create
commands.description: Create a signed operator mandate from generated-proto JSON.

commands.name: revoke
commands.description: Revoke an existing mandate.

commands.name: revoke-session
commands.description: Revoke the active mandate-scoped signing session immediately.

positionals.name: mandate-id
positionals.description: Mandate identifier whose active signing session will be revoked.

commands.name: cancel-standing
commands.description: Cancel a recurring obligation before its next charge.

commands.name: list-all
commands.description: List all mandates visible to the authenticated operator across books.

groups.name: budget
groups.description: Control budget caps, human gating and the emergency freeze.

commands.name: set-caps
commands.description: Set authoritative caps from generated-proto JSON.

commands.name: set-gating
commands.description: Enable or disable mandatory human approval for a budget.

commands.name: freeze
commands.description: Freeze a budget immediately.

commands.name: unfreeze
commands.description: Restore spending under a frozen budget.

commands.name: headroom
commands.description: Compute remaining budget headroom from Treasury records without querying Money Ledger.

commands.name: freeze-book
commands.description: Freeze authorization and unsettled dispatch across one book.

commands.name: unfreeze-book
commands.description: Release one book freeze.

commands.name: freeze-status
commands.description: Read the durable scenario-wide kill-switch state.

commands.name: freeze-all
commands.description: Engage the scenario-wide kill switch.

commands.name: unfreeze-all
commands.description: Release the scenario-wide kill switch.

commands.name: agent-wallet
commands.description: Read the budget wallet address assigned to the verified agent run.

groups.name: approval
groups.description: Read and resolve operator approval requests.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List approval requests, optionally filtered by status.

flags.name: book-id
flags.description: Restrict the approval queue to one custody book.

commands.name: resolve
commands.description: Approve or decline one queued spending request.

groups.name: instrument
groups.description: Register bounded payment instruments without exposing credentials.

commands.name: register
commands.description: Register an instrument from generated-proto JSON.

groups.name: settlement
groups.description: Execute registered rails or attest a manual payment outcome.

commands.name: report-outcome
commands.description: Ask the registered adapter to produce an authoritative outcome.

commands.name: report-manual
commands.description: Record an operator-attested manual payment outcome.

groups.name: wallet
groups.description: Receive-only research wallet custody; no spending authority.

commands.name: create
commands.description: Create a receive-only wallet in operator custody.

commands.name: get
commands.description: Read and revalidate public wallet custody.

commands.name: rotate
commands.description: Deprecated one-shot rotation; fails closed. Use prepare-rotation plus Scenario-to-Cloud wallet-recovery rotate so DBM verifies the newest off-host tombstone before the old scalar is deleted.

commands.name: receipt-check
commands.description: Read a Base native-USDC transfer receipt for a Treasury wallet without posting or allocation.

commands.name: receipt-recheck
commands.description: Recheck a retained Base receipt observation against current canonical chain state.

commands.name: receipt-checks
commands.description: Read retained Base native-USDC receipt checks for a Treasury wallet and transaction.

commands.name: prove
commands.description: Produce a fixed non-payment address-control proof.

commands.name: qualify-recovery
commands.description: Verify a same-host encrypted recovery bundle.

commands.name: recover
commands.description: Restore a missing key from verified encrypted recovery.

commands.name: prepare-rotation
commands.description: Prepare an idempotent signed revocation tombstone and successor while retaining the old wallet scalar for operator DBM publication.

commands.name: commit-rotation
commands.description: Commit a prepared wallet rotation only after the operator supplies the exact verified newest off-host tombstone receipt.

commands.name: export-portable-recovery
commands.description: Create a portable encrypted key-only recovery bundle. Pipe the operator-held secret on stdin; the encrypted bundle is stored privately in Treasury data for DBM transport.

flags.name: secret-stdin
flags.description: Read the operator-held recovery secret from stdin.

commands.name: restore-portable-recovery
commands.description: Restore an encrypted key-only bundle. Pipe the operator-held recovery secret on stdin. After DBM restores the Treasury data root on this node, the API reads its private bundle automatically; use --bundle-file only to upload ciphertext from a local file.

flags.name: bundle-file
flags.description: Optional path to encrypted bundle bytes to upload instead of using the API's DBM-restored private bundle.

flags.name: witness-file
flags.description: Optional path to the authenticated public wallet metadata sidecar paired with --bundle-file.

flags.name: revocation-file
flags.description: Optional signed revocation tombstone paired with the selected off-host snapshot; revoked wallet bundles are refused.

flags.name: secret-stdin
flags.description: Read the operator-held recovery secret from stdin.

commands.name: receipt-fund
commands.description: Submit retained finalized receipt evidence to Money Ledger and fund its budget from authenticated acceptance.

commands.name: receipt-funding
commands.description: Read a durable receipt delivery and its Money Ledger acceptance.

commands.name: provision-budget
commands.description: Derive a budget wallet or rotate its mandate session key with a durable retry key.

flags.name: rotate-session
flags.description: Retire the active generation and create the next; requires mandate-id and rotation-idempotency-key.

flags.name: rotation-idempotency-key
flags.description: Stable unique key for this rotation; reuse it unchanged when retrying.

commands.name: budget-wallet
commands.description: Read a derived budget wallet address.

commands.name: fund-intent
commands.description: Create a local-fork funding intent with an exact amount and valuation basis.

commands.name: fund-intent-get
commands.description: Read funding intent, verified receipt and notification status.

commands.name: fund-confirm
commands.description: Verify a submitted transaction against the funding intent and post accepted evidence.

commands.name: fund-list
commands.description: List funding intents for one budget.

commands.name: withdrawal-destination-set
commands.description: Allowlist an operator-owned withdrawal destination using generated protobuf JSON.

commands.name: withdrawal-preview
commands.description: Persist a local-fork withdrawal fee and time quote for an allowlisted destination.

commands.name: withdrawal-execute
commands.description: Execute an approved local-fork withdrawal; real-value execution is gated.

commands.name: withdrawal-get
commands.description: Read the retained withdrawal outcome.

omitted.reason: No CLI command is defined for rail unknown-outcome reconciliation.
